title: Sanitize on-call gists and add compact telemetry-delta exporter
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add on-call gist sanitizer to strip secrets and long traces before attachments; include a compact telemetry-delta exporter to reduce snapshot payloads for on-call notebooks. Backwards-compatible; no config migration required.
description:
Motivation: On-call responders often paste full gists or debug payloads into incident threads. Those artifacts can contain secrets (env variables, tokens), long raw traces that bloat attachments, and PII (IP addresses). At the same time, SLO/telemetry snapshots we ship to on-call pages are often full historical series; for rapid triage we only need deltas and a few contextual aggregates. This PR introduces two ergonomic features to reduce noise, risk, and size: (1) an on-call gist sanitizer that redacts secrets and trims large stack traces while preserving human-readable context; (2) a compact telemetry-delta exporter that produces small, delta-first payloads for incident snapshots and the oncall CLI.

Change summary (single-string): - Add gist_sanitizer module with configurable redaction rules (env var patterns, token-like patterns, IP addresses, email obfuscation) and a trim policy for long stack frames. - Add delta_exporter that computes per-metric deltas and top-k contributors over a rolling window, emits compact protobuf/JSON payloads, and supports rate-limited export to incident storage. - Add CLI export_snapshot for oncall to produce compact snapshots used by incident-bot and the web console. - Add tests for sanitizer and exporter plus integration test exercising CLI path. - Update docs with recommended oncall workflow and opt-in config knobs. - Small Helm chart values update to enable exporter in non-prod clusters by default.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for gist sanitizer patterns and trimming - [x] Unit + integration tests for delta computation and exporter backpressure - [x] Docs: oncall/gist-handling.md and telemetry/exporter.md - [x] Manual validation on staging incident-bot flow - [x] Security review for redaction patterns (SUP-889) - [x] Feature toggles via chart values for gradual rollout
Commits (high-level): - 5fb8c7e: initial gist-sanitizer implementation, baseline patterns and API - 8c2a1d4: add exporter core + proto, delta algorithm and top-k - b1d9ae3: CLI wiring and env-driven config - c0f4b12: tests and CI flakiness fixes (mock telemetry backend) - a3f5b9d: docs and small chart value changes
Files changed (high-level): - slo_toolkit/oncall/gist_sanitizer.py: new sanitizer core, pattern config, public sanitize_text API - slo_toolkit/telemetry/delta_exporter.py: delta calculation, worker queue, backpressure handling - slo_toolkit/cli/export_snapshot.py: small CLI wrapper used by incident-bot when capturing snapshot - tests/test_gist_sanitizer.py + tests/test_delta_exporter.py: coverage for edge cases - docs/oncall/gist-handling.md: guidance and examples - charts/values.yaml: feature flags to enable delta exporter per-environment
Review conversation (excerpt, single-str: "Ethan Romero (reviewer) @ 2024-10-24: Can we make the default IP redaction stricter (strip last octet) to avoid accidental PII leaks? Also please add a regression test that includes IPv6." "Maya Patel (author) @ 2024-10-24: Updated sanitizer to mask last octet for IPv4 and replace IPv6 groups except the prefix; added test cases in test_gist_sanitizer.py." "Lena Kowalski (reviewer) @ 2024-10-26: The delta exporter algorithm looks good but the worker queue could still allow bursts that exceed S3 request quotas. Can we add a token-bucket limiter?" "Maya Patel (author) @ 2024-10-27: Implemented a simple token bucket with configurable rate and burst; added docs about expected cost improvements (roughly 4-7x smaller snapshot size in our staging runs)." "Omar Aziz (approver) @ 2024-10-30: Verified staging incident replay with sanitized gist and compact snapshot; approving for merge once CI passes."
CI summary (single-string):
- Initial CI run: lint ok, unit tests failed (flaky telemetry mock timing)
- Second CI run: fixed timing in tests; all unit tests + integration tests passed
- E2E staging smoke: manual run succeeded
- Security scan: no high-risk patterns found
- Final CI status: pass
Compatibility and rollout: Both features are opt-in via chart values: sloToolkit.features.gistSanitizer and sloToolkit.features.deltaExporter. Defaults in non-prod clusters enable deltaExporter; production remains opt-in to allow gradual validation. The sanitizer runs locally in the oncall bot process before storing or attaching gists; it is safe to enable without changing downstream consumers because redaction preserves a readable summary. No DB schema changes.
Performance/observability: Added metrics (slo_toolkit.gist_sanitizer.redactions_total, slo_toolkit.delta_exporter.bytes_before, slo_toolkit.delta_exporter.bytes_after, slo_toolkit.delta_exporter.rate_limited) and tracing spans for exporter worker cycles. Benchmarks on staging show median snapshot size reduction from ~240KB to ~47KB for our synthetic incident dataset and CPU overhead <5% on the bot worker.
Follow-ups: - Add a small UI affordance in web console to show 'redaction summary' for sanitized attachments (ENG-4219) - Expand redaction rules to detect common credential formats from partner SDKs - Add a per-tenant allowlist for raw dumps when specifically authorized by incident owners
Merge: Squash-and-merge performed after approval by Omar Aziz. Merge commit: a3f5b9d2c7e4f1b6d2c9a1f0b6e3d2c4e7a9b1c0.
notes_for_support: If customers report missing fields after sanitizer enabled, ask for sanitized vs raw sample (redacted) and check feature flag for tenant. For snapshot size concerns, verify exporter rate and burst limits in values.yaml and check slo_toolkit.delta_exporter.* metrics in staging/production. SUP-889 tracks exceptions under support flow.
security_review_notes: Short summary: redaction rules curated with security team; SUP-889 cleared high-risk tokens; added tests to ensure no full secrets leaked in outputs. Sensitive patterns are configurable and can be extended via org-level config.
testing_summary: Unit coverage increased by ~8% for oncall modules. Integration test simulates an incident with a 30s telemetry window and validates payload sizes and redaction. E2E manual validation done on staging with incident-bot replay.
